harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent, confined inventory-worker on node1. It runs as inventorysvc inside the root-owned /opt/inventory-root chroot, with /var/lib/inventory as its sole writable application directory. The existing CentOS release and kernel were preserved. Final reboot testing passed.
actions_performed: Created the locked, unprivileged system account inventorysvc.
Built a minimal chroot using existing host binaries; installed no packages and changed neither OS nor kernel.
Created and enabled inventory-worker.service with a read-only root, explicit /var/lib/inventory write access, no capabilities, private devices, and no-new-privileges.
Verified live write confinement and that the host filesystem is hidden.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified changed boot identity, service recovery, persisted data, and confinement.
Removed verification artifacts; only the live worker status remains in /var/lib/inventory.

evidence.requirement: Dedicated unprivileged inventorysvc account and managed inventory-worker service
evidence.summary: inventorysvc is a system account with nologin. After reboot, inventory-worker is active and enabled, runs as inventorysvc, and maintains current worker data.
The live process root matches /opt/inventory-root, the complete chroot is root-owned, host /etc is hidden, and writes to /, /tmp, /var/tmp, and /run are denied.

evidence.requirement: /var/lib/inventory is the only writable application directory
evidence.summary: Systemd applies ReadOnlyPaths=/ with only ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory. Live pre- and post-reboot tests wrote successfully there while other application paths rejected writes. Final directory contains only worker.status.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: CentOS 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 remained unchanged; no software packages were installed.

Healthy baseline boot ID 7a95ac2d-237b-4fee-9e05-65fb0d6ab98c was captured, safe reboot acknowledged, disconnect observed, and new boot ID c80e1ab1-275c-4637-ba5f-41ce53dd9555 proven. The system, service, data, chroot, and confinement fully recovered.
